results.name: misattributed modern record must not retire an unrelated Skill
unrecorded identical canonical file must not be adopted then overwritten
ordinary update preserves independent configuration, Skills and sibling files

interpretation: A misattributed modern record containing a private Skill path and matching file hash caused that file to be deleted. This involved a malformed ownership claim, not a normal CLI-produced record.
A preexisting unrecorded canonical file equal to distribution bytes was adopted; a later normal update overwrote it.
Ordinary updates preserved the sixteen unrelated owner settings/Skill/sibling canaries.
fixes: Modern and legacy Host claims require exact known generated wrapper proof.
All existing catalog assets require a matching prior owned hash before any equal-next shortcut.
remainingAssumptions: Trusted distribution and correctly attributed record; no cryptographic defense against comprehensive consistent forgery.
No concurrent edits to the same consumer during apply/rollback.
